L1_round_trip.definition: independent regex parser maps each claim sentence back to formal slots (task/modality/role/asset/owner) and checks them against the example's structured fields and independently re-derived alias map

L2_dual_implementation.definition: second executor re-derives fact label and scope evidence from the candidate's full record set rebuilt from the frozen action store, following the written spec (event-scan ordering), with no code shared with the generator beyond data formats

claim_language.note: guarantee covers the controlled language only

mutation_tests.purpose: guard against a vacuous pass: tampered inputs must produce diffs

verdict.L1_round_trip: PASS 3755/3755 — every claim sentence re-parses to exactly the formal slots of its example (task/modality/role/asset/owner), against an independently re-derived alias map
verdict.L2_dual_implementation: PASS 3755/3755 — an independently written executor (event-scan over the frozen action store, no code shared with the generator) reproduces every fact label and all three scope evidence sets
verdict.controlled_language: 3 templates, no free rewrite; guarantee covers the controlled language only
verdict.human_role_remaining: spec-level review of the written task semantics (30 min), not per-example annotation
